== English errata comparison sources ==
The timing changes from just winning a battle or duel where the character was lost to the loss of the eligible character in a battle or duel you won. Both full faces and both cutouts say Immediate Effect.

Players Committee, Decipher Errata, official text as of January 2013, PDF page 23.
